declaration: RULES.md DECL-P4-4 item 1 material M2a, item 2 tiling (as DECL-P4-2 item 2)
eligible_rule: valid_fraction >= 0.5 (canvas mask = grid mask nearest-neighbour x10; beyond canvas = invalid)
display: raw uint8 prediction, 0 outside mesh-valid, builder.area_downscale (cv2.INTER_AREA) to 1068 x 1068, builder.png_bytes (IHDR/IDAT/IEND only); 1068/T = 0.1204 display px per canvas px = 53.40 px/mm
file_names: tiles/20260623141924-w010-027_r<r>_c<c>.png (not uuid; the orchestrator renames and keys on import per DECL-P4-2 item 2)
stats_definition: mean, std, frac_ge_150 over raw canvas pixels inside mesh-valid, before downscale

check.rule: median <= 2.0 and p95 <= 5.0 vox (2.4 um frame) over 20000 valid native vertices, seed 20260926

keys.r<r>_c<c>: float32 (n,3) x,y,z in 20260608103018 voxels (native tifxyz vertices)
keys.r<r>_c<c>__2p4: float32 (n,3) x,y,z in 20260411134726 voxels, the chosen method (= __2p4_affine here)
keys.r<r>_c<c>__2p4_affine: same points through the published affine
keys.r<r>_c<c>__grid_rc: int32 (n,2) native grid row, col of each point

tile_points.selection: valid native vertices whose canvas cell origin (10*grid index) lies in the tile; uniform subsample without replacement, rng seed [20260926, r, c], <= 4096
tile_points.all_vertices: not saved (about 0.8 M vertices per tile, about 1 GB in total, beyond the push limits); every vertex is recoverable from the official native tifxyz via grid_rows/grid_cols per tile

eligibility_A1.rule: DECL-P4-4-A1 item 1: read iff valid_fraction >= 0.5 AND frac_mesh_points_outside_1129_volume < 0.5
eligibility_A1.outside_definition: native point (x,y,z) outside unless 0<=x<X, 0<=y<Y, 0<=z<Z with (Z,Y,X) = 20260608103018 level-0 .zarray shape [59969, 36006, 32354]
eligibility_A1.points: the tile's saved 4096 points (tile_points.npz r<r>_c<c>); checked against every valid vertex of the tile
